title: Employee held-out two-domain campaign
description: Fixed unseen two-domain employee batch: the accepted industrial quote from an authorized price list under taught terms, and the supplier-invoice reconciliation against purchase order and receiving records. The set was fixed before scoring; a changed set or a changed scoring version is a new attempt and must be recorded as such.

source.note: Observation shape is the held-out campaign script's durable state: per-case assignment/step/deliverable results, plus run-level restart and effect counts.

scoring.rule: A case passes only when every declared check matches the durable observation. accuracy = passed cases / declared cases. A missing case is not observed and cannot pass.

heldout-quote.note: The independently computed quote total must come from the authorized price rows and the taught terms; delivery is served through the approved equivalent after the restart.

heldout-reconcile.note: The invoice must reconcile to the receiving record and the purchase order, and the delivered review document must show the independently computed total.
